module.title: Work: Notifications
module.description:
Notifications for users.
Notifications are interruptions after user login.
This module comes with:
- CRUD management - HTML editor - recipient assignment by roles - status process / work flow - hook on after login to interrupt work
module.author: Christian Würker
module.sql:
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>notification_messages`; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `<%?prefix%>notification_messages` ( `notificationMessageId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `creatorId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `type` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `priority` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `status` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `title` varchar(250) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL, `content` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci, `link` varchar(250) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL, `dateStart` date DEFAULT NULL, `dateEnd` date DEFAULT NULL, `createdAt` decimal(12,0) unsigned NOT NULL, `modifiedAt` decimal(12,0) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`notificationMessageId`), KEY `creatorId` (`creatorId`), KEY `type` (`type`), KEY `priority` (`priority`), KEY `status` (`status`), KEY `title` (`title`), KEY `dateStart` (`dateStart`), KEY `dateEnd` (`dateEnd`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>notification_recipients`; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `<%?prefix%>notification_recipients` ( `notificationRecipientId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `notificationMessageId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `userId` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL, `status` tinyint(1) NOT NULL, `createdAt` decimal(12,0) unsigned NOT NULL, `modifiedAt` decimal(12,0) unsigned NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`notificationRecipientId`), KEY `notificationMessageId` (`notificationMessageId`), KEY `userId` (`userId`), KEY `status` (`status`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>notification_recipients`; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `<%?prefix%>notification_messages`;
